item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a reliable source showing Hasina consistently and voluntarily disclosed the tradeoffs behind major decisions in 2024. The strongest positive items are sector-specific reforms or diplomacy, not a broad pattern of candor. The strongest negative items are election manipulation, shutdowns, blame-shifting, and post-facto accountability after collapse, which together outweigh the limited positives.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House says the Awami League manipulated the online information environment, blocked major news sites, and throttled internet/communications around BNP rallies and later unrest. That is direct evidence of manipulating public information to preserve power.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: Freedom in the World 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House reports harassment of the opposition and critical media, politicized anticorruption enforcement, and coercive control over state resources. This supports the view that public commitments and neutral rules were subordinated to partisan advantage.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh election boycott and low turnout","publisher":"Reuters","date":"January 4, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/little-election-fizz-in-bangladesh-as-prime-minister-set-for-another-term/1910693/","summary":"Reuters said the opposition boycott followed Hasina’s refusal to resign and allow a neutral authority to run the election. That is strong evidence against respecting a formal commitment to a genuinely contestable electoral process.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh repression, security-force abuses discredit elections","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/bangladesh-repression-security-force-abuses-discredit-elections","summary":"HRW reported arrests for criticism, repression of opposition, and widespread abuse before the January vote. This shows a pattern of coercion and information suppression rather than open, accountable adherence to formal commitments.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters described internet/text shutdowns, curfew, roadblocks, and troop deployment during the protest crackdown. This is direct evidence of concealing what was happening and using force instead of transparent tradeoff communication.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh crackdown left more than 170 dead, UN says","publisher":"UN OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said internet shutdowns increase impunity and called for an impartial investigation. That strongly indicates Hasina’s government was not being candid about the scale or legality of the crackdown.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence. That reads as blame-shifting and self-protective messaging rather than honest disclosure of tradeoffs or failures.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","1B.8"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s internet shutdown isolates citizens, disrupts business","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladeshs-internet-shutdown-isolates-citizens-disrupts-business-3539448","summary":"Reuters said the government imposed a comprehensive internet blackout during the crisis, cutting off citizens and business activity. That is strong evidence of concealment and deliberate suppression of scrutiny.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Hasina kept the curfew to control protests, army refused to fire","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 6, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusivebangladesh-army-refused-to-suppress-protest-sealing-hasinas-fate-3558302","summary":"Reuters reported the army would not fire on civilians to enforce Hasina’s curfew. The article implies the government was relying on coercion to preserve rule, not respecting limits or honestly accounting for the crisis.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Bangladesh court orders probe into former PM Hasina’s role","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 13, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-court-orders-probe-into-former-pm-hasinas-role-in-grocers-death/2221579/","summary":"This is weak counterevidence: a court-initiated probe shows some accountability became possible after Hasina fled on August 5, 2024. It does not show she kept commitments or allowed scrutiny while in power.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Former Bangladesh PM Hasina demands probe into July killings and vandalism","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 13, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/former-bangladesh-pm-hasina-demands-probe-into-july-killings-and-vandalism/2222256/","summary":"This is the closest pro-accountability signal, but it is post-hoc and came after her flight. It is not evidence of keeping promises or revealing tradeoffs while she still controlled the state.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh IMF Executive Board concludes 2nd review","publisher":"IMF","date":"June 24, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/24/pr24234-bangladesh-imf-exec-board-concludes-2nd-review-ecf-eff-rsf","summary":"IMF said program performance was broadly on track and highlighted exchange-rate realignment, a crawling peg, tighter monetary policy, and tax/subsidy reforms. This is the strongest positive evidence that Hasina’s government sometimes did follow through on formal reform commitments, though under external program pressure.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.4"]},{"title":"Bangladesh public procurement reform / mandatory e-GP","publisher":"Bangladesh Public Procurement Authority","date":"March 6, 2024","url":"https://bppa.gov.bd/media-communication/news-1446.html","summary":"BPPA said e-GP was mandatory and described it as a transparency and accountability reform. This is a concrete positive signal for rules-based administration, even if it is indirect evidence on ruler honesty.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s first national medical education strategy","publisher":"WHO Bangladesh","date":"March 4, 2024","url":"https://www.who.int/bangladesh/news/detail/04-03-2024-advancing-healthcare-excellence-who-s-role-in-developing-the-first-national-medical-education-strategy-in-bangladesh","summary":"The health ministry and WHO used workforce studies and a technical working group to build a medical-education strategy. This is a real positive for evidence-based policy, but it is narrow and does not offset the broader pattern of political opacity.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.4"]},{"title":"Bangladesh reaffirms nuclear non-proliferation and peaceful use","publisher":"Dhaka Tribune","date":"April 30, 2024","url":"https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/foreign-affairs/345281/bangladesh-reaffirms-commitment-to-nuclear-non-proliferation-peaceful-use","summary":"Bangladesh said it would maintain transparency, safety, and IAEA-backed safeguards for nuclear plants. This is a narrow but real example of a public commitment being upheld through institutional safeguards.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.4"]},{"title":"World Bank finances fiscal, banking, and procurement reforms","publisher":"World Bank","date":"June 21, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/21/bangladesh-receives-900-million-world-bank-financing-to-increase-economic-and-urban-resilience-for-sustainable-growth","summary":"The Bank backed fiscal and financial-sector reforms, tax changes, procurement reform, and resilience spending. This is positive evidence that some formal policy commitments were being operationalized, though it is reform design more than proof of durable honesty.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.4","7B.6"]},{"title":"World Bank helps Bangladesh develop Bay Terminal","publisher":"World Bank","date":"June 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/28/bangladesh-world-bank-helps-bangladesh-develop-bay-terminal","summary":"The Bay Terminal project was framed as a trade-competitiveness investment to reduce import/export costs and mobilize private investment. This is a positive policy commitment on long-run growth, but it does not outweigh the crisis-period deception and coercion.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.4"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM asks China to help repatriate Rohingya","publisher":"TBS News / UNB","date":"July 10, 2024","url":"https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/pm-hasina-reiterates-call-china-help-repatriate-rohingyas-myanmar-895921","summary":"Hasina pushed a diplomatic track for Rohingya repatriation through talks with Myanmar and support from China. This is a genuine positive example of using diplomacy rather than force, but it is narrow and does not change the overall assessment.","question_ids":["7B.8","1B.3","1B.4"]}]}
